title: 第19章 娘子要不咱们去当反贼吧第20章 用锦衣卫的烂账平掉曹阿瞒
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“哦？”
神霄眼睛一亮：“你打算怎么做？”
面对神霄的追问，沈浪刚想回答。
但话还没有说出口，
站在神霄身旁的上官冉便是翻了个白眼，吐槽道：
“我说小姐，您是不是得了失心疯了？怎么沈浪说什么您都信？”
“您是不是忘了，一个曹阿瞒都逼得他走投无路了，他拿什么去对付李夫子？对付镇北王啊？”
听到上官冉这话，神霄挂在脸上的期待神色，顿时也变成了严肃。
她觉得上官冉好像说的没毛病。
一个曹阿瞒都能逼得沈浪写出横渠四句，找李夫子帮忙。
现在李夫子与那曹阿瞒已经证明是一丘之貉了，他又岂会是对手？
更何况，在李夫子的背后，还站着一个连她都忌惮三分的镇北王。
沈浪更不可能是对手！
意识到，自己或许真的对沈浪的期待值太高了的神霄，
也是一脸严肃的提醒道：“相公，我知道你想要替我报仇！”
“但咱们不管是做人，还是做事，都必须得看清自己的位置，千万不能因为一时冲动，葬送了自己光明的未来。”
“所以……”
神霄深吸了一口气，略微不舍道：“你要是没有百分之百的把握，还是抓紧跟小冉离开大乾吧，我的仇自己能报！”
“你能报个吉尔！”

“你知道他们的痛处在哪里吗？”
“你知道怎么做，才能让陛下堂而皇之的杀死他们吗？”
“我……”
遭到沈浪训斥，神霄张了张嘴，不知道该如何地回答。
毕竟，她若是知道怎么对付李夫子跟镇北王，也不至于今儿个被气到吐血。
不过，沈浪的言论，倒是让神霄看出，沈浪貌似有解决之法……
“既然相公有把握，那你就说说，怎么才能让陛下堂而皇之地杀死他们？”
沈浪眯起眼：“很简单，以其人之道还之彼身！”
“李夫子他们不是说我写的横渠四句是他们北冥书院的吗？”
“那我就用大亓的语言，写一封他们密谋造.反的书信，强行栽赃他们造.反！”
听到沈浪的解决之法，神霄脸上浮现出了失望之色。
她还以为沈浪能有什么高招呢，敢情只是写一封造谣的书信。
这种事情，要是能扳倒镇北王，今天横渠四句也不至于被李夫子留在北冥书院，颠倒黑白！
于是，觉得沈浪可能还不太了解，大乾王朝真实情况的神霄，也是一脸严肃的提醒道：
“相公，你把镇北王想的太弱了！”
“那家伙权倾朝野，又是二品巅峰武者，就算是陛下，也无法通过一封造.反密信制裁得了镇北王！”
“卧槽，这么猛？”听完神霄介绍，沈浪的眼眸之中也是浮现出了凝重之色。
他还真的是没有想到，原主脑海中没啥概念的镇北王，竟然拥有如此恐怖的体量。
这使得沈浪也立刻意识到，用造.反密信去搞镇北王这种庞然大物，的确不现实！
一旁的上官冉见到沈浪的脸色都变了。

也是忍不住的讥讽道：“要是觉得没办法了，就别在这里装逼了，抓紧去收拾一下东西，趁着城门还没关，送你出去！”
“谁装逼了？我只是在思考，用什么方法，弄死这帮狗东西最稳妥！”沈浪板起脸道。
“呵~”上官冉不屑一笑：“嘴硬的男人，你想到了吗？”
“就这么点小问题，肯定想到了呀！”

"Oh?"
Shen Xiao's eyes lit up: "What are you going to do?"
Facing Shen Xiao's questioning, Shen Lang just wanted to answer.
But the words haven’t been spoken yet,
Shangguan Ran, who was standing next to Shen Xiao, rolled his eyes and complained:
"Miss, have you lost your mind and gone crazy? Why do you believe everything Shen Lang says?"
"Have you forgotten that even Cao Ah Man has forced him to the point of desperation? What can he do to deal with Master Li? To deal with the King of Zhenbei?"
After hearing Shangguan Ran's words, the expectant look on Shen Xiao's face suddenly turned serious.
She felt that what Shangguan Ran said was right.
A Cao Ah Man could force Shen Lang to write four sentences about Hengqu and ask Master Li for help.
Now that Master Li and Cao Aman have proved to be of the same species, how can he be a rival?
What's more, behind Master Li, there is the King of Zhenbei who even she is afraid of.
Shen Lang is even less likely to be an opponent!
Shen Xiao realized that perhaps his expectations for Shen Lang were too high.
He also reminded with a serious face: "Ms. sir, I know you want to avenge me!"
"But whether we are people or work, we must clearly understand our position. We must not ruin our bright future because of impulsiveness."
"So..."
Shen Xiao took a deep breath and said with a little reluctance: "If you are not 100% sure, you should hurry up and leave Daqian with Xiao Ran. You can avenge me on your own!"
"Can you repay Gil!"
"Do you know where their pain points are?"
"Do you know what to do so that His Majesty can kill them openly?"
"I..."
Being scolded by Shen Lang, Shen Xiao opened his mouth, not knowing how to answer.
After all, if she had known how to deal with Master Li and King Zhenbei, she wouldn't have been so angry that she vomited blood today.
However, Shen Lang's remarks made Shen Xiao see that Shen Lang seemed to have a solution...
"Since your Majesty is confident, please tell me how we can let His Majesty kill them openly."
Shen Lang narrowed his eyes: "It's very simple, just treat him the same way he did!"
"Master Li, didn't they say that the four lines of Hengqu that I wrote were from their Beiming Academy?"
"Then I will use Da Qi's language to write a letter to them about plotting to rebel, and forcefully frame them for rebelling!"
After hearing Shen Lang's solution, a look of disappointment appeared on Shen Xiao's face.
She thought Shen Lang had some clever tricks up his sleeve, but she just wanted to write a letter to spread rumors.
If this kind of thing could overthrow the King of Zhenbei, today Hengqu's four sentences would not be left by Master Li in Beiming Academy to confuse right and wrong!
Therefore, Shen Xiao, who felt that Shen Lang might not understand the true situation of the Daqian Dynasty, also reminded him with a serious face:
"My lord, you think King Zhenbei is too weak!"
"That guy has all the power in the government and is a second-grade peak warrior. Even His Majesty, he can't punish the King of Zhenbei with a secret letter of rebellion!"
"What the hell, so fierce?" After listening to Shen Xiao's introduction, Shen Lang's eyes also showed a solemn look.
He really didn't expect that the King of Zhenbei, who had no idea in the original owner's mind, would have such a terrifying size.
This made Shen Lang immediately realize that it was indeed unrealistic to use secret rebel messages to engage a behemoth like King Zhenbei!
Shangguan Ran's expression changed when he saw Shen Lang.
He couldn't help but sarcastically said: "If you feel that there is nothing you can do, stop pretending to be cool here, hurry up and pack your things, and I will send you out while the city gate is still open!"
"Who is showing off? I'm just thinking about the safest way to kill these bitches!" Shen Lang said with a serious face.
"Ha~" Shangguan Ran smiled disdainfully: "A tough-talking man, have you thought about it?"
"It's such a small problem, I must have thought of it!"
